identity.name: Casio Vintage A168
identity.one_liner: The 1989 A168 — the chrome-and-resin round watch that defined the 1990s schoolkid digital. The watch that defined "wearing a watch" for a generation.

narrative.story: The A168WA was introduced in 1989 as the round-case companion to the square F-91W and A158. The chrome bezel and bracelet-style resin strap made the watch the most-dressed-up of the entry Casio digital lineup. The 593 quartz module is the same as the F-91W, with the 7-year battery, daily alarm, hourly chime, stopwatch, and calendar. The A168 is the most-cited affordable round digital watch and the watch a watch collector buys as their "I want a watch but I do not want to think about it" piece.
narrative.collector_notes: The A168WA has a round case, distinguishing it from the square F-91W and A158. The matching A169W (silver dial) and A178W (black dial) round out the A168 line.
